# Software Engineering Take-Home Project
## DataBoard — File Upload, Analytics & Visualisation

---

## 1. Overview

Build a full-stack web application that lets authenticated users upload CSV files, store them in a
PostgreSQL database, compute basic statistics on any column, visualise two columns as an
interactive ECharts plot, preview raw data, and delete datasets they no longer need.

---

## 2. Tasks

- Register and log in with a secure email/password flow.
- Upload a CSV file with a user-provided dataset name.
- Browse all previously uploaded datasets.
- Preview the first N (25) rows of any dataset.
- Compute a statistic (min, max, or sum) on any numeric column.
- Plot two columns as a scatter, line, or bar chart using Apache ECharts.
- Delete a dataset with confirmation.

### Extended Features

| Area | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Auth | Passwords hashed with bcrypt/argon2 (not left as an exercise). JWT has an expiry; document your refresh/re-login strategy. |
| Testing | At least one meaningful test suite (unit or integration) covering the compute endpoint's edge cases: empty column, all-nulls, non-numeric column requested as numeric. |
| Pagination | `GET /dataset` pagination (`?page` & `?limit`) must be genuinely implemented, not stubbed — verify with a dataset list >1 page. |

---

## 3. Screens

- **Screen 0:** Login page — login and registration forms. Redirect to Home on success.
- **Screen 1:** Landing/Home page. Nav bar with logo, links: Home, Data, Plot. Welcome message.
- **Screen 2:** Data management. Upload a CSV + name it. View list of uploaded datasets. Delete a dataset. Preview available data.
- **Screen 3:** Analytics and visualization. Compute a statistic on a column. Plot two columns.

## 4. API Specification

### 4.1 Authentication

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|---|---|---|
| POST | `/auth/register` | Register — `{ email, password }`. Returns JWT. |
| POST | `/auth/login` | Login — `{ email, password }`. Returns JWT. |

### 4.2 Datasets

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|---|---|---|
| POST | `/dataset` | Upload CSV with a name provided by user. |
| GET | `/dataset` | List all datasets owned by the authenticated user. Supports `?page` & `?limit`. |
| GET | `/dataset/:id/preview` | Return first 25 rows + column names of the dataset. |
| DELETE | `/dataset/:id` | Permanently delete the dataset and all its rows. |
| POST | `/dataset/:id/compute` | Compute operation. Body: `{ column, operation: 'min'\|'max'\|'sum' }`. |
| GET | `/dataset/:id/plot` | Return first 25–30 values of column1 & column2. Query: `?col1=&col2=`. |

---

## 5. Technology Requirements

- **Backend:** Use a Python-based web framework (e.g., FastAPI, Django, or Flask).
- **Frontend:** Use a JavaScript-based framework or library (e.g., React, Vue, Angular, or Next.js).
- **Database:** Use PostgreSQL.

You are free to select additional libraries and tools that best suit the implementation.
